user_story: As a guest, I want the system to reject more than 10 guests per booking so that room capacity is respected.

positive.title: Booking with 10 guests should be accepted
steps: Go to the booking page as a guest
Set the number of guests to 10
positive.expected_result: The booking is successfully created with 10 guests.

negative.title: Booking with more than 10 guests should be rejected
steps: Go to the booking page as a guest
Set the number of guests to 11
negative.expected_result: The system displays a message indicating that no more than 10 guests are allowed and the booking is not processed.

edge.title: Booking with 0 guests should be handled gracefully
steps: Go to the booking page as a guest
Set the number of guests to 0
edge.expected_result: The system displays a message indicating that at least 1 guest must be selected and does not process the booking.
